pros: Keeps all project tasks, files, and conversations organized in one central place.
Facilitates collaboration and transparency across cross-functional teams.
The flat-rate pricing model for unlimited users offers good value for a small business.
cons: Lacks advanced project management features like complex task dependencies or native time tracking.
The search function for older projects can be inefficient and frustrating.
Limited visibility into project progress and upcoming deadlines due to basic calendar functionality.
changed: cons.3: 'Receiving excessive notifications, even for completed projects, was a minor annoyance.' was replaced by 'Limited visibility into project progress and upcoming deadlines due to basic calendar functionality.' based on the note '[friction] My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool.'
